C gate adopted resolution (b) sub-/128 generalized semantics; closed with ekcc (same change set). All three l327 asks delivered: (1) operator-seeded static delegation table = lichen_rpl_prefix_delegate/revoke/delegation_authorizes/delegations_reset implementing the free-function API this issue noted as uncommitted in rpl_routing.h (static storage, bounded CONFIG_LICHEN_RPL_MAX_PREFIX_DELEGATIONS=64, no malloc, canonicalizing, idempotent, fail-closed: /0 and >128 -> LICHEN_RPL_ERR_INVALID, capacity -> LICHEN_RPL_ERR_FULL, exact-match only); (2) generalized Target parsing in extract_updates (prefix_len 1..=128, >=ceil(prefix_len/8) octets, canonicalized, /0 rejected) AND the wire validator validate_dao_options relaxed to Rust is_generalized_target_body semantics (this was the hidden fourth layer - it rejected generalized bodies at DAO parse before the gate ever ran); (3) parity tests in lichen/tests/rpl_dao_auth: delegated /64 end-to-end Applied (canonical snapshot + route), foreign /64 + /0 denied pre-mutation (whole-root_state memcmp), delegation API fail-closed incl. capacity/idempotency/exact-match/origin-binding, /127 boundary, non-canonical bodies canonicalized, /63 vs /64 denied. /0 fails closed at all four layers (delegate, wire, gate, extract). Evidence: 9/9 rows under ASan+UBSan; five regression suites green; cppcheck zero new findings vs HEAD.
